rules.sentence: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is defined as left ventricular hypertrophy that develops in the absence of causative hemodynamic factors, such as hypertension, aortic valve disease, or systemic infiltrative or storage diseases (Figs. 287-15 and 287-16).
It has previously been termed hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (HOCM), asymmetric septal hypertrophy (ASH), and idiopathic hypertrophic subaortic stenosis (IHSS).
